name: av_stock_weekly
description:
Weekly OHLCV price history for one stock from Alpha Vantage (TIME_SERIES_WEEKLY), covering 20+ years.
Returns: {"Meta Data", "Weekly Time Series"} keyed by week-ending date, each with "1. open" to "5. volume".
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker).
Daily bars: av_stock_daily; monthly: av_stock_monthly.
Example: {"symbol": "MSFT"}
